source.previewStageNote: The .blend also holds a PREVIEW_Stage collection (camera, sun, sand disc, sky colour) used only for the preview render. It is not exported.
source.determinism: re-exported from the deterministic skeleton (noise.noise only) so the light-strand variant yggdrasil-strands.glb lines up exactly

dimensions.belowGround: roots dive to y = -4.5 so the tree can sit on uneven sand; trunk flare meets y = 0

root.name: Yggdrasil
root.transform: identity at world origin = trunk centre on the ground plane (y = 0)

YGG_Roots.content: 11 massive exposed roots (buttressed, arching, travelling horizontally then diving), 3 helically twisted companion roots, secondary roots and rootlets. 5 roots carry recessed ember grooves on their upper face.

YGG_Trunk.content: Fused core with geometric bark ridges and burls, plus 7 helically intertwined strands. 3 strands carry recessed ember grooves on their outer face.

YGG_Branches.content: The 7 trunk strands continue seamlessly as the major limbs (shared vertex ring at the split, normals stitched), a central leader, 49 level-1 and 198 level-2 branches.

attributes._sway: float 0..1 wind weight (0 at trunk, ~1 at twig tips). three.js attribute name: _sway

YGG_Foliage.content: 308 layered foliage pads made of single cupped leaf-spray cards (2 quads each, 1.25-1.95 m) that mostly face out of their pad, so leaf faces meet the light and no card is seen edge-on. Atlas: 2x2 sprays (emerald / forest / olive / mixed), each a tapered twig carrying ~350 veined 9-13 cm leaves. Custom normals blend pad volume with card facing; the leaf normal map adds per-leaf tilt and fold. The inner crown is kept open so the trunk and limbs read.

attributes._sway: float 0..1 wind weight (pad distance from trunk + height; card tops slightly higher)
attributes._phase: float 0..1 random phase per foliage pad, for desynchronised wind

YGG_EmberChannels.content: 8 thin vein strips that sit 70% recessed inside grooves cut into the roots (5) and trunk strands (3). They are separate geometry so the orange glow can be driven entirely in three.js.

uv.uv (TEXCOORD_0): u = 0..1 across the vein, v = 0..1 along this channel
uv.uv1 (TEXCOORD_1, 'EnergyUV'): u = channel id ((i + 0.5) / 8), v = global energy coordinate: 0.0 at outer root ends -> 0.5 where roots meet the trunk -> 1.0 at the top of the trunk channels. Animate a pulse as smoothstep on (uv1.y - time) to make energy flow from the roots up into the tree.

materials.YGG_Root_Bark / YGG_Trunk_Bark / YGG_Bra: PBR metallic-roughness, single-sided. Share three textures: bark_basecolor (sRGB, dark walnut + earthy brown), bark_normal (OpenGL +Y), bark_orm (R = AO, G = roughness, B = metallic 0). Separate materials so each part can be tinted or animated independently.
materials.YGG_Leaves: alphaMode MASK (alphaTest 0.5), double-sided, roughness 0.58, KHR_materials_specular factor 0.7 (no grey sky sheen). leaf_atlas.png base colour + alpha, leaf_normal.jpg tangent-space normal map. Kept green; no orange baked in.
materials.YGG_EmberChannel: near-black base, emissive (1.0, 0.36, 0.05) at emissiveIntensity 1. No orange light is baked into any bark or leaf texture: bloom, aura, pulses and volumetrics belong in three.js.

budget.glbBytes: about 7.4 MB (Draco geometry + 5 shared textures: 4 x 2048 JPEG, 1 x 2048 PNG leaf atlas)
